title: Extract and standardize signal features
description: You turn signal windows into six-feature observations for the model.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You visit complete signal windows and compute root mean square amplitude, mean absolute sample difference, and sign-crossing fraction. Each window becomes one feature row.
You add power sums from two frequency bands and kurtosis, a measure of distribution shape. You also store each window's start and end indices.
You extract features from ecg_f and record the matrix dimensions. The supplied output reports 298 rows and six columns.

steps.question: What divisor does the scaler use when a column's standard deviation is smaller than eps?
steps.answer: It substitutes one for that standard deviation. transform still subtracts the column mean before dividing.

steps.description: You fit the scaler on X and use its stored means and standard deviations to create Xs. Xs contains the standardized feature observations.
